scope: Actual TP8 Half-column/Float-row GEMMs with HCCL and original CPU Half Linear controls.

kernel.scope: vision blocked FP16xFP16 -> FP32 L0C -> FP32 UB bias -> ONE Half GM; no hardware bias operand; no Half partial; no FP32 weight shadow

host_padding_contract.m: zero A rows up to m_pad; padded output rows equal the bias and must be cropped before model use
host_padding_contract.k: zero A columns and zero W K-rows up to a multiple of 128 (vision MLP 4304 -> 4352)
host_padding_contract.n: zero W trailing rows and zero bias entries up to a multiple of 128 (vision MLP 4304 -> 4352); crop output columns
host_padding_contract.bias_values: exact original Half bias promoted to Float32; zero for added N entries

capability.runtime_soc_label_note: the runtime reports the short SoC name Ascend910 for this original 910A-generation part; 30 usable cube cores
